# sonarqube_portfolio (Data Source)

Looks up a portfolio by key. Requires Enterprise edition or above.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_portfolio" "payments" {
  key = "payments"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Portfolio key.

### Read-Only

- `application_branches` (Map of Set of String) Branches selected for each application of the portfolio, by application key.
- `applications` (Set of String) Keys of applications in the portfolio.
- `branch` (String) Branch analysed for TAGS, REGEXP and REST selection.
- `description` (String) Portfolio description.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `name` (String) Portfolio name.
- `portfolios` (Set of String) Keys of the portfolios included as sub-portfolios.
- `qualifier` (String) `VW` for a portfolio, `SVW` for a sub-portfolio.
- `regexp` (String) Project key pattern, for REGEXP selection.
- `selected_projects` (Attributes Set) Projects, for MANUAL selection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--selected_projects))
- `selection_mode` (String) `NONE`, `MANUAL`, `TAGS`, `REGEXP` or `REST`.
- `tags` (List of String) Project tags, for TAGS selection.
- `visibility` (String) Portfolio visibility, `public` or `private`.

<a id="nestedatt--selected_projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `selected_projects`

Read-Only:

- `project_key` (String) Key of a project selected manually into the portfolio.
- `selected_branches` (Set of String) Selected branches; null means the main branch.
